name: pr-watch
description: A line above the prompt for each pull request Claude opens, showing its GitHub workflows with a progress bar, then ready to merge, the failing job, or what blocks it, and telling Claude the same without being asked.

wake.title: Wake Claude
wake.description: What a watched pull request tells Claude unasked. Checks: ready to merge, a failed job, conflicts, requested changes, and a merge's checks. Checks and comments: also comments and reviews by people other than you. Off: only you hear it, from the line and its toasts.

botComments.title: Bots wake Claude
botComments.description: Which comments and reviews from authors GitHub marks as a bot also tell Claude, when Wake Claude includes comments. Reviews: a review bot's reviews, not plan, coverage or preview comments. Comments and reviews: everything a bot posts.
